topic: Understanding Pack Expansions in Variadic Macros
explanation: In advanced C programming, pack expansions are used within variadic macros and templates to process an arbitrary number of arguments efficiently. They enable developers to generate repetitive code patterns, perform compile-time computations, or manipulate argument packs in a flexible and scalable manner. Mastery of pack expansions is essential for writing highly generic, reusable, and optimized code that leverages the full power of the C preprocessor and variadic functions.
keywords: Pack expansion, variadic templates, argument pack, variadic macro expansion
